device.name: Unitree Go2 Isaac Lab flat-ground task

facts.text: The repository targets Isaac Sim 4.5.0 and Isaac Lab 2.1.0 or 2.1.1 on Ubuntu 22.04
Isaac Sim 4.5.0, Isaac Lab 2.1.0 or 2.1.1 and ROS2 Humble are installed externally before the repository is used
The documented run command is python main.py from the repository root
The Go2 robot is the UNITREE_GO2_CFG articulation spawned at prim path {ENV_REGEX_NS}/Go2
Go2RSLEnvCfg subclasses ManagerBasedRLEnvCfg and is the environment configuration
The action term is a JointPositionActionCfg for asset unitree_go2 over joint_names ['.*']
The policy observation concatenates base_lin_vel, base_ang_vel, projected_gravity, base_vel_cmd, joint_pos, joint_vel, actions and height_scan
Projected gravity carries UniformNoiseCfg(n_min=-0.05, n_max=0.05)
The height_scan observation is clipped to (-1.0, 1.0)
The policy observation group sets enable_corruption=False and concatenate_terms=True
The height scanner uses a GridPatternCfg with resolution 0.1 and size [1.6, 1.0], offset 20 m above the base
The velocity command ranges are all zero: lin_vel_x, lin_vel_y, ang_vel_z and heading are (0, 0)
RewardsCfg and TerminationsCfg are empty pass classes, so the configuration declares no reward or termination terms
The environment uses decimation 8 and a simulation timestep of 0.005 s
The run loop derives its step period as sim.dt * decimation, 0.04 s for decimation 8 and sim.dt 0.005 s
The configured episode length is 20.0 s and is_finite_horizon is False
The joint position action scale is 0.25
The application instantiates Go2RSLEnvCfg()
The run loop resets the environment with env.reset() and advances it with env.step(actions)
get_rsl_flat_policy builds the environment with gym.make('Isaac-Velocity-Flat-Unitree-Go2-v0', cfg=cfg)

determinism.notes: the fake reseeds Python's random.Random on reset(seed) and is otherwise deterministic, so one seed and one action sequence repeat a trajectory in this package; the upstream Isaac Lab environment seeds its own numpy and torch generators and was not compared with the fake

gaps: kinematic stand-in only: no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction or PhysX; the upstream environment is an Isaac Sim 4.5.0 simulation (README.md:4-8) and none of that physics is modelled here

the fake's action and observation widths and bounds are placeholders: the joint count comes from the external UNITREE_GO2_CFG articulation (go2_env.py:2,47) and the term widths from isaaclab mdp, neither stated in the clone; the real policy observation concatenates the eight terms of go2_env.py:74-94, while the fake returns a four-number summary

the fake always returns reward 0, matching the empty RewardsCfg of go2_env.py:120-123, and never terminates or truncates (TerminationsCfg is empty and is_finite_horizon is False, go2_env.py:120-129 and :171-172); the 20 s episode length is declared but not enforced

no rendering, camera, LIDAR, contact sensor, height scan, ROS2 topic or RSL-RL policy is modelled; the run loop's ROS2 bridge and checkpoint loading (main.py:77-88, go2_ctrl.py:70-83) are not part of the capabilities this driver serves

the upstream environment was never run: Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, ROS2 Humble and a GPU are external prerequisites (README.md:41-43); the sim backend (gymnasium.make of the registered task) was not exercised and would use the task's registered default config, because this family driver cannot pass a Go2RSLEnvCfg built from the clone without importing it
snapshot and restore are not offered: the fake exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation is frozen: after an e-stop no step or reset is served until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, while the last observation stays readable
